title: Card Widget
subtitle: Material design panel with rounded corners, elevation, and shadow styling.

properties.name: elevation
properties.description: Controls the size of the shadow beneath the card, creating depth and a floating Material Design visual effect.

properties.name: color & shadowColor
properties.description: color changes the card background surface color. shadowColor changes the color tint of the cast drop shadow.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: Configures corner rounding (BorderRadius) and borders/lines along the card outline.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: Determines if and how elements (like images or background decorations) are clipped to match the card's rounded corners.
